properties.title: SWoMo: Neuro-Symbolic World Model for Cataract Surgery Simulation

properties.version_basis: PDF identified by SHA-256 against assignments.json; title page read.

properties.description: Neuro-symbolic cataract-surgery world model combining a rule-based simulator, scene graphs and a video diffusion model trained on inverse-paired simulated and real videos.
Kinematics extraction from real video, Godot rule-based simulator, scene-graph encoders and a two-stage video diffusion model with ControlNet conditioning on the simulated sequence.
properties.world_model_status: supporting component (rule-based transition with learned appearance model)

properties.algorithm: Video diffusion model with graph, first-frame and simulated-video conditioning

properties.population: cataract surgery videos from two public datasets

properties.description: CATARACTS, 50 videos after phase filtering, video-level split ratio 50/6/44
Cataract-1k, 868 videos after phase filtering, video-level split ratio 80/10/10
Synthesis quality, conditioning adherence and downstream phase recognition on two datasets, with the evaluated partition not stated

properties.algorithm: LVDM modified for scene-graph triplet conditioning

Generated sequences are compared with real clips by detection-based adherence, although the conditioning kinematics come from the same real clip so the check resembles replay fidelity and not forecasting.

capability_assessments.rationale: Downgraded from L2 to not_world_model under the ontology core-identity rule: although SWoMo evaluates tool-motion-conditioned video synthesis adherence against baselines (Table 1) and downstream phase-recognition augmentation (Table 2), the state transition T(.) is a fixed rule-based Godot mesh simulator driven by kinematics extracted from the same real clips (replay/translation fidelity rather than learned transition dynamics), and only the sim-to-real video diffusion appearance renderer and scene-graph encoders are learned (dynamics.learned_hybrid is partial, not present). Core world-model identity is therefore not met, and SWoMo is retained as a supporting component.

Core world-model identity is therefore not met, and SWoMo is retained as a supporting component.

gate_assessments.rationale: Splits are at the video level and counts are given, but patient-level separation, the partition used for each table and overlap with the training data of the upstream segmenters and tracker are not stated.
Adherence and distribution metrics against baselines are reported, but the evaluated partition is not stated and no successor-state error of the simulator is reported.
Autoregressive generation of full videos is used for augmentation, but no fidelity or drift is measured across chained sequences.

legacy_cells.B: SWoMo: Neuro-Symbolic World Model for Cataract Surgery Simulation
legacy_cells.C: Sivakumar, Ssharvien Kumar, Johnson, Akwele, Dhingra, Anirudh, Frisch, Yannik, Ghazaei, Ghazal, Mukhopadhyay, Anirban
legacy_cells.S: Can action-conditioned cataract-surgery scene dynamics support realistic video synthesis while retaining tool and anatomical motion?
legacy_cells.AI: Real cataract-surgery video frames; extracted anatomical configuration and tool kinematics; simulated video sequences; scene graphs and segmentations
legacy_cells.AJ: nnU-Net for pupil/iris segmentation; pretrained CoTracker for landmark tracking; global/local scene-graph encoders; video diffusion network with temporal convolution and attention; ControlNet conditioning branch
legacy_cells.AK: Pretrained CoTracker is used to track annotated skin landmarks across video frames.
legacy_cells.AL: Global graph encoder: contrastive learning between scene graphs and segmentations; local graph encoder: reconstruct masked real-video regions from scene graphs.
legacy_cells.AM: Global and local graph-encoder outputs are concatenated with timestep embeddings; a ControlNet branch encodes simulated video and injects features into the diffusion backbone.
legacy_cells.BD: Per-step tool-motion change (∆ktool), represented by tool-tip position, orientation, and articulation parameters including bending/opening angle.
legacy_cells.BL: Videos sampled at 4 frames per second into 16-frame sequences; images resized to 128×128.
legacy_cells.BN: Rule-based simulator with parameterized eye/tool geometry; tool and anatomy kinematics govern mesh transformations and scene interactions.
legacy_cells.BS: Rule-based simulator produces next simulated state/frame and segmentation; conditional video diffusion translates simulated sequences into realistic surgical videos.
legacy_cells.BV: Diffusion noise-prediction mean squared error; global scene-graph contrastive objective; local masked-region reconstruction objective.
legacy_cells.CA: Diffusion-model training distributed across four NVIDIA A40 GPUs.
legacy_cells.DZ: Video synthesis quality/diversity: FVD, FID, and LPIPS. SWoMo CATARACTS: FVD 265.4, FID 40.8, LPIPS 0.450; Cataract-1k: FVD 123.0, FID 20.1, LPIPS 0.388.
legacy_cells.EC: Downstream phase recognition with Real + SWoMo augmentation: CATARACTS accuracy 82.5 and F1 83.0; Cataract-1k accuracy 94.2 and F1 95.2.
legacy_cells.EI: Compared with StyleGAN-V, Endora, MedSora, LVDM, MOFA, and SG2VID for synthesis; SWoMo reported stronger synthesis quality/adherence on most comparisons.
legacy_cells.EK: Ablations remove simulated-image conditioning (SWoMo-✗IMG) or scene-graph conditioning (SWoMo-✗SG); Table 1 reports synthesis and adherence metrics for both datasets.
legacy_cells.EL: Authors report degraded synthesis near component boundaries/tool–tissue interactions under simulated/real misalignment, causing smoothing artifacts.
legacy_cells.FB: Hybrid state: explicit eye/anatomical and surgical-tool geometric parameters with a structured scene graph of object attributes and relations.
legacy_cells.FL: SWoMo composes a rule-based simulator of eye anatomy and instrument motion, a structured scene-graph representation, and a two-stage conditional video-diffusion pipeline that translates simulated scenes into realistic surgical video.
legacy_cells.FM: Decouples procedural motion generation from visual appearance: explicit symbolic scene dynamics and scene graphs drive a diffusion model trained with inverse-paired real/simulated videos.
legacy_cells.FN: On CATARACTS and Cataract-1k, SWoMo reports improved video synthesis/adherence over most baselines; generated data improves downstream phase-recognition results, and qualitative examples cover unseen tool entry directions and tool combinations.
legacy_cells.FQ: Authors identify a gap in prior surgical video-generation/simulation methods: limited direct stepwise tool control, weakly grounded interactions, and poor generalization beyond training distributions.
legacy_cells.FR: Evidence supports action-conditioned cataract-scene simulation and video generation, not identified treatment effects, a planning/control policy, robot execution, or prospective clinical benefit. The reported metrics concern generated-video quality/adherence and downstream phase recognition.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M3 Belief-state service; M4 Action service; M5 Dynamics adapter; M6 Rollout service; M7 Outcome & causal layer
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Pass the paper’s specified action and time context explicitly into the state-transition interface; preserve the boundary between predictive action sensitivity and identified intervention effects.
legacy_cells.FX: Complete 11-page extracted PDF text (form feeds checked). Read title/byline/abstract (p. 1); introduction (pp. 1–3); all methods, inverse-pairing, simulator, scene-graph and diffusion details (pp. 3–6); datasets, quantitative and qualitative results, ablations, generalization, downstream phase-recognition results and Tables 1–2 (pp. 6–9); conclusion (p. 9); references through p. 11. No separate limitations section was present. Tables 1–2 were text-extracted and legible; no unreadable-table issue encountered. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: A:I prefilled metadata was preserved; the PDF did not contradict it. Evidence supports a procedural/action-conditioned simulator and conditional video generator (L2), not identified clinical treatment effects or a planner/controller. Readiness is retrospective evaluation on two datasets (R2); no prospective patient benefit is shown. Author claims of public code/data/weights are recorded as claims from the abstract. No limitations section was present. Evidence QA: 37/66 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (56.1%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 60 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 8 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis.
